name: goose-bridge
title: Goose Bridge
description: A Raycast bridge for the Goose CLI AI agent.
author: anschmieg

commands.name: index
commands.title: Ask Goose
commands.subtitle: AI Agent
commands.description: Ask Goose AI agent a question and see the response in real-time

arguments.name: query
arguments.placeholder: What would you like to ask?

commands.name: sessions
commands.title: List Sessions
commands.subtitle: Goose Sessions
commands.description: View and resume previous Goose sessions

preferences.name: goosePath
preferences.title: Custom Goose Path
preferences.description: Path to the Goose AI binary (leave empty for auto-detection)

preferences.name: enableVoiceOutput
preferences.title: Enable Voice Output
preferences.description: Speak the final output using macOS 'say' command
preferences.label: Enable voice output

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
